findings: Global field index rendering and context-dependent definition projection are measurable shared startup/selection/search work, including closed-index selection.
Startup samples also contain substantial native/program/GC activity; these samples do not establish DNSSEC construction as the sole cause of startup latency.
Legacy and DNSSEC replay-start profiles do not establish an expensive single JavaScript root cause.
decision: Inspect narrowly duplicated index-context definition lookups while keeping normal default-open index and all fields/cases. Do not add another cache around existing definition memoization without a concrete avoided operation.
measurementLimits: Profiled wall times and CPU self samples are diagnostics, not latency comparison values; fresh uninstrumented preserved-method comparisons and owner dispositions remain required.
